description: Curious young thinkers for the development of our well-being and earth
summary: Our project is an interactive project designed to make learning about Earth and environmental issues fun and engaging. Users can select topics such as climate change, weather, oceans, forests, pollution, and natural disasters. The system provides information through audio, visuals, and interactive displays, and can use real-time environmental data. A special Earth Health Meter shows the current environmental condition using simple indicators. The project can be developed using technologies such as a Raspberry Pi or Arduino, touchscreen, speakers, APIs, and AI, helping users better understand Earth and how they can protect it.
details:
It is an interactive system that provides information about Earth and environmental topics in an engaging way. Users can select topics such as climate change, weather, pollution, oceans, forests, wildlife, and natural disasters.

How does it work?
1.The user selects an Earth-related topic using a touchscreen, buttons, or voice command.
2.The system processes the selected topic.
Relevant information is displayed on a screen and explained through a speaker or voice output.
3.The system can show environmental data and images related to the topic.
4.An Earth Health Meter can provide a simple indication of environmental conditions.

What benefits does it have?
1.Makes environmental education fun and interactive.
2.Helps students and the public understand complex environmental topics more easily.
3.Encourages awareness about climate change and pollution.

What do you hope to achieve?
Our main goal is to make information about Earth easier, more interesting, and accessible to everyone. We hope to increase environmental awareness and encourage people, especially students, to understand environmental problems and take small actions to protect our planet.


Tools, coding languages, hardware, and software
Depending on the version of the prototype, the project can use:
Hardware:
Raspberry Pi or Arduino
Touchscreen/display
